units.source_text: 据女儿之意，父亲最好陪送我们进京。”

en.t: In my daughter's view, Father had best accompany us to the capital."
She urged him earnestly to go.

units.source_text: 但明石道人说：“有种种原因，不便离去。”

en.t: But the Akashi monk said, "For various reasons, it would not be convenient for me to leave."

units.source_text: 然而他想起了女眷一路上不便之处，又非常担心。

en.t: Yet when he thought of the difficulties the women would face along the way, he became very worried again.
